# Everest Home

> Everest Home is a custom furniture manufacturing and interior design company serving all of Lebanon.
> The workshop is based in South Lebanon, and the company designs and builds made-to-order furniture,
> wooden decorations, professional painting and finishing, and complete turnkey interior projects
> across every Lebanese region — from idea to installation.

## Services

1. Furniture Manufacturing — living rooms, sectional sofas, bedrooms (master & kids), dining and
   coffee tables, storage units and built-in wardrobes, fully custom furniture made to measure,
   re-upholstery and renewal of old pieces.
2. Wood Decor — 3D wooden wall panels, built-in TV walls and media units, modern curved designs,
   luxury CNC wood details and slats, decorative ceilings and beams, custom wooden doors and partitions.
3. Painting & Finishing — professional furniture painting (PU & lacquer), matte and gloss multi-color
   finishes, natural wood grain enhancement, restoration and repainting of old furniture.
4. Interior Design — on-site consultations, space planning, furniture/lighting/accessories selection,
   color and material harmony, 3D visualization before execution, turnkey project management.

## Areas Served

All of Lebanon — every governorate: South Lebanon (Tyre, Nabatieh, Sidon, Bint Jbeil,
Marjayoun, Hasbaya), Beirut, Mount Lebanon (Jounieh, Metn, Keserwan, Chouf), North Lebanon
(Tripoli, Akkar), Bekaa (Zahle), and Baalbek-Hermel. The workshop is based in South Lebanon
and projects are delivered across the whole country.

## Why Everest Home

- 100% local manufacturing with high quality standards
- Fully custom designs tailored to each space and client
- 10+ years of combined craftsmanship experience, 500+ completed projects
- Specialized team for carpentry, upholstery, painting, and design
- Careful selection of sustainable, high-quality materials
- Competitive prices with no middlemen, on-time delivery
- Free first consultation; detailed free quotes

## Process

1. Consultation — listening to the client's idea and needs (free).
2. Design — turning the idea into a clear vision, including 3D visualization.
3. Build & Install — manufacturing with premium materials and professional installation.
4. Delivery & Follow-up — final quality check and after-delivery support.
